name: Processor_B_9Q_Heavy_Hex
description: 9-qubit heavy-hex-inspired processor (nodes 0-8). 12 undirected edges (24 directed). Primary topology for QFF 2026 Phase 1 Processor B benchmarking.
optimal_4q_subgraph_description: Optimal 4-qubit cycle subgraph for ZZFeatureMap embedding: nodes [1,2,5,6] form a dense cycle within the heavy-hex graph with edges (1,2),(2,5),(5,6),(6,1),(2,6).

noise_params.description: Frozen QFF 2026 synthetic noise: 1Q depolarizing p=0.001 on [rz,sx,x], 2Q depolarizing p=0.005 on [cx], symmetric readout error p=0.01 on all qubits.
